description: Área Queimada Distrito Federal - 2007 a 2024 is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). As camadas shapefile "Área queimada 30m" são um conjunto de dados geoespaciais de referência produzidos pelo MAPBIOMAS a partir interpretação automática de imagens; obtém-se o produto em formato raster e a posteriori realiza-se a a vetorização utilizando software GIS. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Vegetação, Área Queimada, Queimada, Corpo de Bombeiros Militar do Distrito Federal, CMBDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
